title: Be a licensed employment agent
what: Carry on business, or hold out, as an employment agent only while licensed.

sources.title: Employment Agents Registration Act 1993 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) carry on business as an employment agent; or (b) hold himself or herself out as an employment agent, unless that person holds a licence under this Division

administration.who: Director under the Employment Agents Registration Act 1993 (SA) (chief executive of the Minister's department)

sources.title: Employment Agents Registration Act 1993 (SA)

sources.quote: Director means— (a) the person for the time being holding, or acting in, the office of the Chief Executive Officer of the Department of the Minister to whom the administration of this Act is committed;
